reviews.text:
I cannot say enough wonderful things about Rockin’ Paws and the owners Sarah & James! Finding people I truly trust with Luna isn’t easy, especially because she struggles with anxiety, but they have been absolutely amazing with her.

They take the time to understand Luna and what she needs to feel comfortable and safe. They send me pictures and videos while she’s there, which gives me so much peace of mind—and I love getting to see her having fun! When her tummy was upset, they even went above and beyond by giving her rice and probiotics to help settle it.

It’s obvious that Sarah & James genuinely care about the dogs they look after and treat them like their own. They’ve been patient, attentive, accommodating, and incredibly kind to both Luna and me. Knowing she is somewhere she’s understood, cared for, and loved means more to me than I can say.

I’m so grateful we found Rockin’ Paws. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for boarding or doggie daycare. Luna definitely gives them two paws up! 🐾❤️
Been going here for several years. So much better than going to a large boarding place. Sarah is great with the dogs and my dog loves it here.
Opals favorite hang when I'm out of town. Good people.

We have been bringing our dog Mako to Rockin Paws for the past couple years and he absolutely loves it. Every time we mention the words “Rockin Paws” at home he gets the zoomies and runs around with excitement. We have also done the 2 week board and train and he came back a totally different, well trained dog. Highly recommend!

My pups always have a great time there. I am also a HUGE fan of the training. The daily updates and photos while boarding are always lovely to receive. If I could afford to send my dogs more, I definitely would!

Pretzel loves Rockin Paws (clearly from the photos)!! We did the 2 week board and train, and boarding when we are out of town, and I never have to worry when he is here. Sarah clearly loves all pups and the pics I get are an awesome bonus!

We have been boarding our dog Mako at Rockin’ Paws for the past two years and he loves it! Every time he’s there we get picture updates (like this one) and know that he’s in good hands. He has also done the two-week Board and Train Program where he learned both behavioral and leash manners! Could not recommend Rockin’ Paws enough!!
Rockin Paws is AMAZING! My dog loves being there and doesn’t want to come home with me anymore! I trust Sarah and James 100% with my senior dog. I don’t know what I would do without them!
Thank you! We love Miss Daisy🌼 …

Our chocolate baby Dublin absolutely loves it at Rockin paws! He’s definitely a tired pup when we get him back which is no easy task with a young lab. Sarah and James do an absolutely amazing job. Plus the photos and videos they send never cease to entertain 😂 many many thanks! …

The absolute best place to train and board your pups. My girl went in while I was recovering from major surgery for about a month, and came back a different dog. She is a pleasure to walk now and she is socialized and well-behaved. I wouldn’t board her anywhere else!

Ok, so I've never had the opportunity to bring my dogs here. They were old and have passed, BUT this place is amazing. I so enjoy looking at photos and videos. What dog whispers these 2 are. Just look at all the other reviews. Never disappointing. If you're looking for these services for your fur babies, there will be NO disappointments. 🐕‍🦺🐾🐕🐾
We have trained and boarded our Opal with Rockin Paws and she loves it as much as we do. Thank you for your service when we go out of town it is a major relief knowing she is with loving people.
Rockin’ Paws is the best boarding in the valley.  My dogs always love to go and come home happy and not wanting to leave.  Highly recommended

I’ve been sending my pup here for almost a year and I couldn’t recommend it more. Sarah is very knowledgeable and takes great care of all the dogs she watches. I know my dog is in great hands when he’s with her. She’s also super flexible- which i always really appreciate with my schedule.

Sarah has such a love for dogs and a way with them.. she is the dog whisperer… she did wonders for our sweet boy Samson who just adores her and misses his buddies(her dogs)and just hanging out with all the other dogs.. you can never go wrong with Rockin Paws 🐾 …

A wonderful home-based + positive trainer dog boarding & daycare & training spot. My dog has gone here since we moved to Arizona 2+ years ago and he doesn’t go anywhere else for boarding. Sarah will send lots of photo and video updates, will keep you updated if your dog doesn’t feel great or needs anything, and she helps teach them positive life skills that help them at home (like practicing settle, building confidence playing in the agility courses). She also really cares about their safety and monitors summer temps well. The best part is the dogs have structured days - nap time, play time, etc. They don’t just endlessly play and become overtired which can create behavior issues. She also is quick to respond if you need to adjust appointments or have requests. She also cares for the community, donating during the LA fires and donating to orgs that serve the unhoused with pets. I love her & her partner and how they care for my dog. She makes sure he eats and is well taken care of too, which other facilities have neglected my dog in the past on longer trips. I can’t recommend them enough. I have high expectations and trust them fully - plus my dog LOVES it there and has a blast. He’s the happiest there over in home care because of her structure.
We love Rockin paws.  It is the perfect place to take our dog when we go out of town.  I know she will be safe and well taken care of when she is  there.  Highly recommended.!

We dropped off our 16 week old Irish Setter Poodle mix with Sarah and can’t say enough about the experience and results. I had done a lot of work myself with training and I thought things were going fairly well, but after two weeks with Sarah our pup is on another level!

The biggest thing is that she is so much more calm and composed than before. She went from frequent puppy energy and ourbursts to.. an almost adult dog level when we are at home relaxing. It’s amazing. She knew all basic commands to varying levels and each command is now significantly more reliable. Lastly, before dropping her off I could walk her 3-5 minutes before the stimulation and distractions made it hard for her to stay focused. Now, 20-25 minute walks are calm and at heel. She also got water exposure, dog-dog socialization, and is much more calm with grooming.

Seriously,  everything is multiple levels better. I told Sarah I feel like she matured 2 months during that two weeks.

While she is there you get daily updates and pictures.

We are going to keep using their boarding services and feel really lucky to have found them.
Rockin' Paws is simply the best for boarding. We know our dog is always safe and having a blast. We also love the updates and pictures. Wouldn't send our boy anywhere else.

Rockin’ Paws has been an absolute lifesaver for us and our quirky rescue pup. Sarah and James are amazing! Their incredible experience and natural rapport with dogs shine through in every visit. Our girl always comes back home happy, healthy, and visibly loved. Plus, the excellent communication is the cherry on top. We honestly couldn't recommend them enough—it’s truly the best boarding experience I’ve ever had as a lifelong dog owner. 🐾

There is just no one I’d trust more than Sarah to watch over my two boys. Zedd, my rescued lab, was very anxious and peeing all over the place when I first brought him home. He spent 3 weeks with Sarah and came back a changed man, seriously! He has such a bright personality and Rockin Pawz is to thank for that. Both the boys absolutely LOVE going there for boarding. You won’t find another place in the valley where they treat your dogs like their own, they ACTUALLY get plenty of play time in their amazing backyard (designed with so many activities for them), and just love for the price point Rockin Pawz offers. I don’t consider anyone else when boarding my boys. Sarah texts and sends photo updates often. I’ve just never had a problem. Absolutely love this company.

Sarah is truly the best!  She has helped shape our doodle, Cooper, into the very best dog.  Whether it is daycare, boarding, or training, Cooper is always excited to go see Sarah.  Truly, we think he likes hanging at Rockin’ Paws her more than our house.  Highly recommend!!!
I always feel safe and happy leaving my dog here. Great owners!

Fabulous, highly experienced people with love and skills to spare. This is my #1 choice for training and it should be yours too. Whether you have a couple issues or lots of to overcome, you will be happy with the outcome!  Don't forget to continue the work at home until it is 2nd nature for both of you!  Enjoy your best friend again!
